source: Icy Veins / Wowhead TBC guides + WCL top parses
summary: Keep your DoTs rolling (Corruption, Curse of Agony, Unstable Affliction, Siphon Life) and fill with Shadow Bolt. Maintain Curse of the Elements if you're the assigned curse.

Searing Pain.note: a fire filler - Affliction should fill with Shadow Bolt, not Searing Pain

Rain of Fire.note: AoE filler used on single-target - usually a misclick or wrong build

Hellfire.note: self-damaging AoE on a single-target parse

advisory: Affliction's damage is in keeping every DoT at full uptime - Shadow Bolt is only the gap-filler between refreshes. Fight notes: on movement-heavy fights (Vashj phase transitions, Kael weapons/adds, Leotheras) pre-cast your DoTs before you have to move so uptime does not slip, and refresh on the run since DoTs need no cast time; on add-heavy pulls (Hydross adds, Karathress, Mount Hyjal waves) Seed of Corruption is your AoE filler instead of single-target Shadow Bolt, and make sure Curse of the Elements stays on the primary target if you are the assigned curse.
